borrow_charge: sum(|short weight| x annual_rate / 252) per session held; dollar-volume tier from the prior session's 21d median
days_to_cover_top_decile_exclusion: not applied: the eligible short names are ETFs and a fixed list of large/mid-cap dual-class shares and mega-cap constituents; the cross-sectional DTC percentile is defined on the 3,000-name gap universe and is meaningless on a 10-pair or 10-stock list; illiquid classes are already excluded by the 5M dollar-volume rule
judged_cost: frozen flat 10 bp per side per leg, borrow deducted (main and stress models reported alongside, not judged)

judgment_tiers.K1: anchor >= 1.1882 and stress >= 0.6447 and median 20 bp after-borrow CAGR > 0 in both windows
judgment_tiers.K2: S3 inverse-63d-vol monthly blend Sharpe minus vol-matched S3+SHY control >= 0.05 in both windows (sleeve = overlay + T-bill)
judgment_tiers.dsr_trials_note: 16 candidates + 3 direction mirrors + 3 direction random placebos
judgment_tiers.judged_value: median over rebalance offsets (21 monthly, 5 weekly) or entry delays 0/1/2 (direction B) or the single calendar version (direction C composite) of the after-borrow 10 bp Sharpe
judgment_tiers.placebo_condition: keep/watch tiers require the candidate anchor Sharpe > the maximum anchor Sharpe of its 20 random-ranking/random-sign placebo seeds; otherwise tier = reject_placebo
judgment_tiers.strong_keep: K2 edge >= 0.10 in both windows, or K1 with anchor >= 1.4853 and stress >= 0.8059 (S3 median-offset values)

main_cost_model: per side per leg: 5 bp flat + 0.5 x trailing-21d Abdi-Ranaldo spread (ml30.spread_estimate_from_ohlc, lagged one session)
price_hygiene: sanitize_price_matrices defaults on all stock/ETF close and open; signal-date exclusion of split-like close/close or open/close ratios (t32 is_split_like_ratio) for stock legs; pairs also excluded when either class has a split-like one-day ratio inside the z window; outcomes never used for filtering

short_eligibility.dv21: median of close x volume over the prior 21 sessions

stress_cost_model: per side per leg: 10 bp flat + 1.0 x the same spread (doubling)
